title: Occult history in NASA and launch pad choices
summary: unnamed speaker tells of Occult history in NASA and launch pad choices, about unspecified at NASA, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There's a lot of occult history, occult history in NASA. Some of the the nomenclature that was used for certain missions and and the choosing of, you know, launch pad 33 and some other things were very deliberate.

plain: An unnamed speaker on Jesse Michels's show says there is a lot of occult history, meaning ties to secret mystical traditions, inside NASA, the US space agency. The speaker says the names given to some missions and the choice of things like launch pad 33 were deliberate, and passes this on as something heard from others. The suggestion is that symbolism played a hidden part in the space programme.
